extDescription.message: Audit sites for AI-agent readiness: robots.txt, llms.txt, Markdown negotiation, MCP, Content Signals. Local, no analytics.

cannotScanPage.message: This page can't be scanned — open a regular http(s) website.

unreachedProbes.message: $COUNT$ probe(s) got no response (timeout or network) and were judged as absent.

scannedAt.message: Scanned at $TIME$ — checks run locally in your browser.

welcomeTagline.message: X-ray your site for AI agents.

welcomeSubtitle.message: See what AI agents really see — robots.txt, markdown, MCP, Content Signals — right in your browser.

stepScanDesc.message: One click on the toolbar icon audits the current tab against the open agent standards.

stepFixDesc.message: Every failed check ships a ready-to-paste prompt for your coding agent.

stepVerifyDesc.message: Rescan and watch the score climb — evidence for every verdict, nothing hidden.

tipIcon.message: Click the toolbar icon — Chrome opens the side panel, so the report stays next to the page

tipEvidence.message: Expand any check to see the raw evidence behind its verdict

tipPrompt.message: Copy a fix prompt and hand it to Cursor, Claude Code or your agent of choice

tipReference.message: Curious what a high score looks like? Try the scan on spintax.net — a living reference of the standards

ctaButton.message: Try it on a living reference

savedSite.message: Saved — every scan is recorded to history

dashboardSubtitle.message: Saved sites, batch scans and score history

emptyDashboard.message: No saved sites yet. Save the current site from the panel, add one above, or pull in your open tabs.

invalidOrigin.message: Enter a valid http(s) site, e.g. https://example.com

noTabsToAdd.message: No scannable tabs found (open an http(s) page, or grant site access in Firefox).

settingsChecksHint.message: Off-by-default checks mirror Cloudflare's tool. Turning one on affects every scan.

diffReasonDns.message: expected: DNS records can't be probed from a browser

diffReasonWebMcp.message: expected: in-page detection needs the page open

diffReasonMcp.message: expected: we accept the MCP card shapes deployed in the wild

diffReasonA2a.message: expected: we also read the legacy agent.json path

settingsWatchHint.message: Watched sites are rescanned on a schedule; you are told when a check that used to pass starts failing. Everything stays local.

watchPermissionMissing.message: Notifications need one more permission — toggle watch on a site and allow it when asked.

regressionBadgeTitle.message: Checks that started failing since the last alert: $CHECKS$

promoText.message: 301.st is the service behind this extension: edge rules synced to Cloudflare at scale, domain monitoring, geo-routing and A/B traffic streams. Several fixes this tool suggests — markdown negotiation, Content-Signal in robots.txt — are exactly the kind of edge rule it deploys for you. Free during the open beta.

settingsBrowsingHint.message: What the extension does on the pages you open, and what the toolbar icon shows.

browseAutoScanHint.message: Off by default: this sends the same requests a manual scan does, once for every site you open. History is still recorded only for saved sites.

badgeScore.message: Show the current page's score on the icon

badgeAlerts.message: Show unread monitoring alerts on the icon

settingsNewsHint.message: New posts from 301.sh about agent readiness, redirects and Cloudflare, filed in the same inbox as regressions. Off by default: nothing is fetched until you switch it on.

tipAutoScan.message: The icon shows a score once something has scanned that tab. Turn on auto-scan in the dashboard to have it scored as you browse — it is off by default because it sends requests to every site you open

sessionActive.message: Your session changed what this audit saw
